reviewer: Seed-0 witness review (ora qualify robolab contract-witness)
scope: robolab BlockStackingOrderAgnosticTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (stacked); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.
task_language: Stack the blocks into a tower

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read BlockStackingOrderAgnosticTask terminations: success = stacked(objects=['red_block', 'blue_block', 'green_block', 'yellow_block'], order='None'), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene colored_blocks.usda: red_block, blue_block, green_block, yellow_block among 5 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: World-frame oriented boxes of each pair and their contact sensor (check_stacked).

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (4) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 9a049e975f3b).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 9a049e975f3b): stacked -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 9a049e975f3b): reset_state -> False; beside -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = stacked(objects=['red_block', 'blue_block', 'green_block', 'yellow_block'], order='None'): check_stacked: contact with the lower object and the upper one's box above the lower one's top (or bottom) face.
The success term is stacked only; it has no gripper_detached term, and check_stacked also accepts an upper object whose box is above the lower object's bottom face (nesting).
conditions.interpretation: The termination does not require releasing the top object.
conditions.omission_reason: A predicate weakness is documented for review, not delivered as an exploit; the instruction's intent (a stack) is unchanged.

conditions.interpretation: Contact force bar and bounding-box slack withheld.

public_clauses: The red block, the blue block, the green block and the yellow block must form a single tower, each one on top of another and touching it, in any order.

termination_vs_subtasks.subtasks: stack_any_2_blocks(groups=['red_blue', 'red_green', 'red_yellow', 'blue_green', 'blue_yellow', 'green_yellow'], logical=any) score=0.33; stack_any_3_blocks(groups=['red_blue_green', 'red_blue_yellow', 'red_green_yellow', 'blue_green_yellow'], logical=any) score=0.33; stack_all_4_blocks(groups=['conditions'], logical=all) score=0.34

notes.detail: official limit 1350 native actions (90 s at 15 Hz; 4050 under the default extended budget), against 900 for the longest task admitted before
the stack term does not require releasing the top object

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks

limitations: Generated from the pinned source; the witness (phase B) covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout. Source-derived negative cases marked as such are not executed.
